info.title: Devku Desktop Resource Distribution API
info.description: MCP/Skill publication and administration with private object storage. Resource storage shares Desktop update endpoint and credentials, using the explicitly configured private resource_bucket. Authorized users can obtain S3 presigned download URLs valid for 300 seconds; URLs can be reused until expiry.

post.summary: Upload one ZIP and publish it immediately
post.description: Raw ZIP <=64 MiB. Uploaded object first, then resource metadata commits atomically in PostgreSQL. New resources are active; publishing never changes an existing disabled status. Returns only the uploaded platform. Duplicate tuple or older version is 409. On ambiguous results verify through administrator key lookup and historical version SHA-256. Objects are uploaded to a private resource_bucket; no permanent download URL is returned or persisted.

requestBody.description: ZIP <=64 MiB; manifest.json <=128 KiB; <=1024 entries; <=128 MiB uncompressed.

200.description: Published. data.artifacts contains only the uploaded platform.

patch.description: Does not delete packages, uninstall local files or interrupt downloads already authorized. Blocks new download URL issuance; existing presigned URLs expire within 5 minutes. Publishing while disabled preserves disabled status.

post.summary: Authorize and issue a private download URL valid for 5 minutes
post.description: No request body. Resource must be active, including historical versions. Requires existing administrator or Desktop member authentication. The presigned URL can be reused until expiry; disabling a resource or revoking membership blocks further issuance but cannot revoke an already issued URL. Fetch the URL directly from S3 without User/Model Tokens. No URL is stored in resource metadata.
